description:
Adds a credit card refund transaction that is linked to one or more QuickBooks credit memo transactions. You can link the credit card refund to one or more of those credit transactions.

The `ar_refund_credit_card_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

address.description: If an address request fails, some combination of address fields might be too long. In a Check, BillPaymentCheck, or SalesTaxPaymentCheck message, Address is the address that will print on the check.

addr1.description: The first line of an address.

addr2.description: The second line of an address (if a second line is needed).

addr3.description: The third line of an address (if a third line is needed).

addr4.description: The fourth line of an address (if a fourth line is needed).

addr5.description: The fifth line of an address (if a fifth line is needed).

city.description: The city name in an address.

country.description: The country name in an address, or, in returned Host information (HostRet or HostInfo), the country for which this edition of QuickBooks was designed. (Possible values are US, CA, UK, and AU.)

note.description: In a BillAddress or ShipAddress aggregate, the Note field value is written at the bottom of the address in the form in which it appears, such as the invoice form.

postal_code.description: The postal code in an address.

state.description: The state name in an address.

ar_account_ref.description: `ar_account_ref` points to an Accounts Receivable account. If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

credit_card_txn_info.description: Contains data from the credit card transaction used in the payment. This data originates from a previous qbmsXML credit card transaction.

credit_card_txn_input_info.description: This contains data originally supplied in the QBMS transaction request. This information block shouldn’t be used in CreditMemo requests for QuickBooks 2007 and new versions.

commercial_card_code.description: This optional field is used only for Visa and Master Card commercial cards. There are three types of these cards: purchase, corporate, and business.

credit_card_address.description: The address associated with this credit card.

credit_card_number.description: Credit-card number for this customer or this payment. Beginning with qbXML spec 6.0 and QuickBooks 2007, you must mask the credit card number with lower case “x” and no dashes.

credit_card_postal_code.description: The postal code associated with the address for this credit card.

credit_card_txn_type.description: Indicates the QBMS transaction from which the current transaction data originated, for example, Charge, Authorization, Capture, Refund, VoiceAuthorization, or Void.

expiration_month.description: The month when the credit card expires.

expiration_year.description: The year when the credit card expires.

name_on_card.description: The name on the customer’s credit card.

transaction_mode.description: Indicates whether this transaction came from a card swipe (tmCardPresent) or not (tmCardNotPresent).

credit_card_txn_result_info.description: This contains data returned in the QBMS transaction response. This information block shouldn’t be used in CreditMemo requests for QuickBooks 2007 and new versions.

authorization_code.description: The authorization code is returned from the credit card processor to indicate that the charge will be paid by the card issuer.

avs_street.description: This field contains the value avssPass if the street address supplied in the transaction request matches the customer’s address on file at the card issuer.

avs_zip.description: This field contains the value avszPass if the customer postal ZIP code supplied in the transaction request matches the customer’s postal code recognized at the card issuer.

card_security_code_match.description: This field contains the value Pass if the card security code supplied in the transaction request matches the card security code recognized for that credit card number at the card issuer.

client_trans_id.description: This value is returned from QBMS transactions for future use by the QuickBooks Reconciliation feature.

credit_card_trans_id.description: This transaction ID is returned from the credit card processor.

merchant_account_number.description: This is the QBMS account number of the merchant who is running the transaction using the customer’s credit card.

payment_grouping_code.description: Internal code needed for the QuickBooks reconciliation feature, if integrating with QuickBooks.

payment_status.description: Indicates payment processing status as known by QuickBooks/QBMS integration state. `psCompleted` indicates confirmed success; `psUnknown` indicates status could not be definitively confirmed.

recon_batch_id.description: This value is returned by QBMS from the transaction request, and is used internally by the QuickBooks/QBMS Recon (reconcile) feature.

result_code.description: This contains the status code returned in the original QBMS transaction response.

result_message.description: This contains the status message returned in the original QBMS transaction response.

txn_authorization_stamp.description: This value is used to support the credit card transaction Reconcile feature within QuickBooks.

txn_authorization_time.description: Timestamp indicating the time in which the card processor authorized the transaction.

customer_ref.description: `customer_ref` identifies a customer or customer job. If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored. In SalesReceipt and ReceivePayment, it identifies who receives credit.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

def_macro.description: `def_macro` lets you assign a reusable name to a returned `txn_id` or TxnLineID so later requests can reference it with `useMacro`. This feature requires SDK 2.0+.

exchange_rate.description: `exchange_rate` is the rate from this currency to the company’s home currency at AsOfDate. You can supply a rate when adding transactions, but QuickBooks does not provide rates through the SDK.

external_guid.description: Allows for the attachment of a user defined GUID value.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

payment_method_ref.description: `payment_method_ref` identifies how a payment is made (for example, cash, check, or card type). If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

ref_number.description: `ref_number` is a user-managed transaction reference (for example, a check number). It can be edited and is not guaranteed to be globally unique.

refund_amount.description: Specifies the amount to be taken from the credit transaction you are linking via this aggregate.

txn_id.description: `txn_id` is the unique QuickBooks identifier for a transaction. Use it to reference that transaction in later requests.

refund_from_account_ref.description: In an ARRefundCreditCardAdd, the account which is the source of funds for the credit card refund. Normally this is Undeposited Funds. However, you can specify another account if you wish.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

txn_date.description: The date of the transaction. In some cases, if you leave `txn_date` out of an -Add message, QuickBooks will prefill `txn_date` with the date of the last-saved transaction of the same type.

name: create_ar_refund_credit_card

body.description: The JSON body: the arguments you passed.

headers.description: Send with the request. Resent unchanged when no 201 came back, it answers with the request already queued.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.

webhook.description: JSON Schema of the payload POSTed to webhook_url once QuickBooks answers, with this operation's response_json (data shape and status codes).
